label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param: The variable 'bar' is assigned the value of 'param' when the condition (7 * 42) - num > 200 evaluates to false. Since 'param' originates from user input via getParameter and is directly written to the HTTP response without sanitization, it constitutes a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: bar is assigned param when condition is false; param comes from user input and is written to response without encoding
